Content Calendar Maker

Plan a month of social posts: schedule content per day, save and export.

Click a day to schedule or view posts.

Posts for

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a month with the month picker.
  2. Click a day to add a post (platform + text).
  3. Click a scheduled post to edit or delete it.
  4. Export the month as text when ready.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I schedule posts?

Pick a month, click any day to add a post (platform + text), and it saves automatically to this browser.

Can I set the platform per post?

Yes — each post stores its platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn) shown as a badge on the day.

How do I export the calendar?

Click Export Text to download the whole month as a readable schedule.

Where is the calendar saved?

In this browser's localStorage, keyed by month.
